reuse.why: Extends the existing isWeekendOrHoliday predicate that all holiday-aware date shifting in shared/schedules.ts uses, reusing monthUtils.dayFromDate.

duplication.why: No duplicated logic; the holiday match is factored into one small isHoliday function.

placement.why: Holiday matching stays in shared/schedules.ts beside the predicate that consumes it.

scope.why: Only the predicate and focused tests change.

maintainability.why: A named isHoliday helper makes the two entry formats easy to see and extend.
